protocol.label: Communication Protocol
protocol.help: TCP: LAN-Kit / Ezlink3000 dongles (port 502). UDP 8899: old Wi-Fi-Kit (SSID 'Solar-WiFi…'). Pick UDP if Modbus TCP is not exposed by your dongle.

host.label: Inverter IP Address
host.help: IP address of your Goodwe inverter on the local network

port.label: Port
port.help: Modbus TCP default: 502. UDP Wi-Fi-Kit default: 8899. Leave empty for protocol default.

unitId.label: Modbus Unit ID (Slave ID)
unitId.help: Goodwe ET series default: 247. Check your inverter's Modbus settings.

pollInterval.label: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.help: How often to read data from the inverter (minimum 10s recommended)
